centerRule: For each round, center=-sum(all pre-center individual components)/10; equal addition to each player. Rating=1+scale*sum(net)/rounds.
unknownMapRule: all-zero one-hot before StandardScaler; never substitute another map

doseFormula.HP: (max(sourceD,activeEnemyKills)-activeEnemyKills)/100; kills are resolved enemy source slots within freeze..end
doseFormula.plant: 1; teamGoal/N, N=e.before ownAlive; unresolved same-tick policy retained
doseFormula.enemyFlash: [enemyBlindSeconds,enemyBlindVictims,flashAssists]; one total budget; no extra FA award

notes: Common adapters use only website existing retrospective fields; website lacks rich trajectories/HP/kit/armor/weapon inventory.
Website source default semantics retained, including missing utility fields default zero; missingness is not newly inferred.
e.before built by prior ticks and current elapsed clock; same-tick kills use source-before group.
Feature source validation is parity with frozen existing website contract; current live website schema not queried.
Published source identifiers are relative provenance aliases. Raw study inputs, trained binary objects and individual results are not included.
